Description: Chess Crawl private AWS foundation; starts with zero ECS service tasks until migrations and release gates pass

PrivateSubnets.Description: At least two private subnets in different AZs; dependency-service and provider egress must already exist

FrontendSecurityGroupId.Description: Existing frontend service security group allowed to call the private TLS API

ApiHostname.Description: Private DNS name covered by the ACM certificate; create its Route53 alias separately

ContainerImage.Description: Digest-pinned private ECR image built from all dependent PRs

ApplicationDatabaseSecretArn.Description: Existing Secrets Manager JSON secret containing password (32+ characters); never a secret value

ApiTokenSecretArn.Description: Plaintext bearer credential: static API token in static mode, or provisioned workspace readiness credential in database mode

ApplicationSecretKmsKeyArn.Description: Optional customer-managed key ARN for application secrets; empty uses AWS-managed encryption

DatabaseEngineVersion.Description: Confirm minor-version availability in the selected region before deployment

UsageLog.Description: Enable anonymous workload records for all runtime roles

EventsEnabled.Description: Generate Mercure outbox events only when an independently deployed publisher/hub is available

ApiAuthMode.Description: Static local/bootstrap auth or provisioned and revocable PostgreSQL workspace credentials

DatabaseMaxConnections.Description: Maximum admitted PostgreSQL sessions per process, at least 2. Budget the sum across all runtime replicas.

DatabaseAdmissionTimeoutSeconds.Description: Finite positive session admission wait seconds, within the Linux threading timer range. Restart processes to change their admission settings.

SecurityGroupEgress.Description: Existing private-subnet routes control AWS dependency and provider egress
